name: Jimmy's House of Pizza
seo_title: Jimmy's House of Pizza | Handmade Pizza, Calzones & Subs on Kelley St, Manchester NH
seo_desc: Family-owned pizzeria at 345 Kelley St, Manchester, NH. Fresh handmade pizza, calzones, steak subs, Italian dinners and salads. Order online, pay in store. Call (603) 669-3310.
tagline: Family-owned on Kelley Street. Fresh, handmade pizza, calzones, grinders and pasta at a fair price.
about: Family-owned and operated in Manchester, New Hampshire. We serve fresh, handmade pizza, calzones, grinders, pasta, and more, made with quality ingredients and recipes perfected over the years.
Whether you're dining in, picking up, or calling ahead, we're here to serve you a great meal at a fair price.

findings: The current site has one image in total (the cartoon mascot) and no food photos, so every section is text on flat color.
The menu is a plain price table split across nine tabs; nothing shows what the food looks like or what makes it Jimmy's.
Online ordering requires a phone-number sign-in before the menu even loads, and the site only says "pay in store, cash only" in one line of small caps.
No story, no photos of the shop or the family, no social links, and the hours appear three times in slightly different formats.
The mascot image is a photo of a screen (visible moiré) rather than the original file.
questions: Can we photograph the shop? With no real food photos, the new design uses an illustrated pizza scene; a photo shoot (a dozen pies, the oven, the counter, the family) would let us swap in real images.
The mascot image looks like a photo of a screen. Do you have the original file?
Is 'cash only' still correct for online orders picked up in store? Do you take cards at the counter?
What is the story behind Jimmy's: when did it open, who runs it today?
Do you deliver, or pickup and dine-in only?
Any specials (lunch, Monday pizza night, family deals) we should feature?
